```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r}

# Reproducibility
set.seed(2026)


# Number of participants
n <- 400


# Random allocation: 200 participants per group (treatment and Control)
treatment <- sample(
  rep(c("Control", "New treatment"), each = n / 2)
)


# Generate demographic characteristics
age <- round(rnorm(n, mean = 60, sd = 10))

sex <- sample(
  c("Female", "Male"),
  size = n,
  replace = TRUE
)


# Generate diabetes status:
# 0 = No diabetes, 1 = Diabetes
diabetes <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.35)


# Generate baseline LDL cholesterol (mg/dL)
baseline_ldl <- rnorm(n, mean = 150, sd = 25)


# Simulate the treatment effect:
# Control: expected LDL reduction of 25 mg/dL
# New treatment: expected LDL reduction of 35 mg/dL
treatment_effect <- ifelse(
  treatment == "New treatment", 10, 0
)


# Generate LDL reduction, including individual variability
ldl_reduction <- 25 +
  treatment_effect +
  0.15 * (baseline_ldl - 150) -
  0.10 * (age - 60) +
  rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 15)


# Calculate LDL at week 12
week12_ldl <- baseline_ldl - ldl_reduction


# Simulate adverse events
adverse_event_probability <- ifelse(
  treatment == "New treatment", 0.12, 0.10
)

adverse_event <- rbinom(
  n, size = 1,
  prob = adverse_event_probability
)


# Combine all variables into the dataset
trial_data <- data.frame(
  participant_id = 1:n,
  treatment = factor(treatment),
  age,
  sex = factor(sex),
  diabetes,
  baseline_ldl,
  week12_ldl,
  ldl_reduction,
  adverse_event
)

```



```{r}
# Inspect the dataset
head(trial_data)
str(trial_data)
summary(trial_data)


# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(trial_data))


# Check that participants are distributed equally
table(trial_data$treatment)

# Save the dataset
write.csv(
  trial_data,
  "clinical_trial_data.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


```
